verdict.rationale: Stripe Invoicing documents a full Invoicing API alongside the no-code Dashboard. The API covers endpoints such as invoice preview, emits workflow-transition webhooks, and has official libraries, an MCP server and a CLI. However, no source states that the API matches everything the UI can do, and several capabilities (CSV export, credit notes, branding customization) are documented only through the Dashboard. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API equivalents for the Dashboard-only features (CSV export, credit notes, branding settings), a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
